about: Error pattern -> root cause / fix reference for the verilog-sim skill. Entries are matched case-insensitively against iverilog/vvp/verilator output. Source tag S = docs/troubleshooting.md section.

entries.root_cause: The instantiated module is never defined: mistyped module name, wrong file order (file not compiled), or a -s top module that does not match the hierarchy.
entries.fix: Check the module name in the definition vs. the instance; add the defining file to the compile command; compile with the correct -s top.
entries.sample_error:
design.v:13: error: Unknown module type: sub_modulee
2 error(s) during elaboration.

entries.root_cause: A signal name collides with a (System)Verilog keyword: ref, expect, step, wait, always, ... The parser rejects the declaration and reports both the declaration line and line 1.
entries.fix: Rename the signal (ref_cnt, exp_cnt, ...). See examples/buggy/tb_race_counter notes; we hit this with 'ref' and 'expect'.
entries.sample_error:
tb.v:20: syntax error
tb.v:1: error: Syntax error in variable list.

entries.root_cause: Grammar problem: missing semicolon, unbalanced begin/end or parentheses, or SystemVerilog constructs used while compiling in Verilog-2001 mode.
entries.fix: Report the exact line; fix the statement or add -g2012. Check for full-width punctuation pasted from editors.

entries.root_cause: Signal used but never declared; iverilog does not create implicit nets in every context.
entries.fix: Declare the signal explicitly in the module; compile with -Wall to catch implicit nets early.
entries.sample_error: error: Unable to bind wire/reg/memory 'foo' in 'top'

entries.root_cause: A wire is driven by more than one continuous assignment or port.
entries.fix: Keep one driver; use reg + procedural block, or rename the other net.

entries.root_cause: A variable was used where a constant/parameter is required (width, array size, generate condition).
entries.fix: Use localparam/parameter; runtime values cannot size static constructs.
entries.sample_error: error: reference to 'N' is not a constant

entries.root_cause: Port/net widths differ; high bits silently truncated or zero-extended.
entries.fix: Pad deliberately ({1'b0, a}) or fix the declaration; note that a 32-bit integer literal (15) widens the whole expression while 4'hF does not.
entries.sample_error: warning: width mismatch: port 'y' has width 4 but connected to width 8

entries.root_cause: Missing or inconsistent `timescale between modules: delays are interpreted differently.
entries.fix: Put `timescale 1ns/1ps at the top of every file.
entries.sample_error: warning: Some designs have no timescale declared

entries.root_cause: The self-checking testbench found mismatches: FAIL lines carry the inputs, actual and expected values.
entries.fix: Read every FAIL line; classify per SKILL.md sec.6 (logic / timing / interpretation); open the waveform at that timestamp. Live cases: width_truncation (silent truncation), latch_inferred (missing else), tb_race_counter (tb sync error).
entries.sample_error:
FAIL a=f b=1 sum=0 carry=0 (exp sum=0 carry=1)
FATAL: tb.v:39: TEST FAILED: 2 case(s)

entries.root_cause: Zero-delay combinational loop or a loop with no update (assign a=b; assign b=a;).
entries.fix: Break the loop; add an intermediate register or a #delay in the testbench.

entries.root_cause: Hierarchical name in signals.json does not match the VCD scope path (e.g. tb_gen.dut.a vs tb.dut.a).
entries.fix: Run vcd_checker.py wave.vcd without --signals to list every VCD signal, then fix the config.
entries.sample_error: WARNING: signal not found in VCD: tb.en

entries.root_cause: Combinational feedback loop; often an unintended latch or circular dependency.
entries.fix: Review combinational logic; break loops with registers.

entries.root_cause: Width mismatch (same family as the iverilog width warning).
entries.fix: Align widths; see the width-mismatch entry.
Connect the port or disable the lint check locally.

entries.root_cause: Verilator does not support this construct (delays, fork-join, real, ...).
entries.fix: Refactor RTL to synthesizable code; run testbenches with iverilog instead.
